bio.title: Platform Security & Software Engineer
paragraphs: I’m Abishek VP, a software engineer specializing in platform security, identity integrations, workflow automation, and secure backend engineering. I design and build IAM workflows, password automation, and platform components that handle authentication, directory management, approval flows, and secure communication.

At Securden, I built enterprise-grade IAM capabilities including SSPR, identity provider integrations, directory sync, JIT access workflows, approval engines, password vault operations, and microservices supporting secure platform features. I also develop automation plugins for Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet for dynamic credential retrieval inside CI/CD ecosystems.

My experience spans backend development, identity engineering, platform integrations, DevOps automation, and full-stack solutions across multiple organizations. I enjoy solving challenging problems in secure communication, identity lifecycle management, automation workflows, and distributed system reliability.
Outside work, I build tools, explore automation workflows, guide students and juniors, and mentor peers in software engineering.
